column1: # Key of the 4 Aug 1655 sentence, rebuilt from Patera's decipherment (1892 p. 182 note *). python check.py
# Only the signs that occur. "et" is written in clear. One conflict: the 4th letter of CmCasda (see NOTES.md).
# Review, 27 Oct 2026: every letter value agrees with the reciprocal table printed in MHH XXIII (1874) p. 740, the secret
# script of Rakoczi's envoys Harsanyi and Balogh (a=m b=i c=p d=u e=g f=v h=l k=x n=q o=y r=z s=t). The digits 6, 9, 5 are
# not in that table; they are probably the printer's reading of handwritten b, q, h (= i, n, l). See NOTES.md.
